name: smwmusic-shivering-flood-icicle-frost
title: Shivering Flood ~ Icicle Frost
description:
My entry for 48+72hoSPC #8, designed for the ice cave level. Like all of my rushed original songs, it ended up as a Touhou-style song.

It's somewhat sad-ish and determined-ish song while still having a lightness to it. It also has plenty of @2 and @13 for that icy sound. And @5 too because I like @5 :)


Took me forever to submit this because I couldn't think of a name. Almost went with "Untitled Touhou Ice Song", heh.
